binding: schema-2 sidecar neutral_tail_policy under native-post-seam-power-v1; native producer selects at initialization; strict captures inherit the parsed source, never a harness override; missing means single-bootstrap-v1
origin: native scripted schema-2 recording only; explicit plan, launch and proof lineage
buttons: core hold/trig/release and extension button masks exactly zero
sticks_and_triggers: every core/extension stick or trigger magnitude exactly zero, no deadzone; rest sign bits must remain byte-identical
motion: core acc_speed, Nunchuk acc_speed and MPLS angular velocity exactly zero; every accel/gravity field byte-identical to first recorded rest sample
sample_constancy: all 240 bytes per channel equal that channel's first tail sample, including extension union, MPLS and unk_EC
replay: every retained raw byte/sample/connection compared exactly; no substitutions, normalization or metadata edits
